# `UnderstudyMisuse`

`Rasuvaeff\Understudy\Psalm\Issue\UnderstudyMisuse`

**Class** — **Package:** [rasuvaeff/understudy-psalm](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy-psalm) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy-psalm/blob/a5371cb3f323de133bb20d89ac0cdb2ab2cb572d/src/Psalm/Issue/UnderstudyMisuse.php#L20) — **Version:** v0.8.1

**Extends:** `Psalm\Issue\PluginIssue`

A specification that cannot mean what it says.

One issue type rather than one per rule, because a user configures the
plugin as a whole: `understudy` is either analysing your specifications or
it is not, and having to silence `UnderstudyContradictoryCardinality`
separately from `UnderstudyEmptyClosure` would be a worse contract than
having to silence neither.

No public members beyond what is documented above.
